name: Koinrandorii
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood coin laundry (Fuwafuwa Coin Laundry): a notice about business hours changing, a first day working part-time at the counter, a usage-and-price guide, a first time helping a customer wash a blanket, a comparison of two new-staff training plans, a column about a friend nervous the first time using a coin laundry, teaching a new part-timer the machine-breakdown and lost-item procedure, an essay on why coin-laundry use keeps growing, a temporary closure notice for equipment inspection, a column on tailoring service to different kinds of customers, a notice of revised usage rules, a reflection on the meaning of a dryer's smell, and a one-year cooperation report with a local elderly-welfare group. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
